dataset.name: UCI Parkinsons Telemonitoring
dataset.citation: Tsanas A, Little MA, McSharry PE, Ramig LO (2010). Accurate telemonitoring of Parkinson’s disease progression by noninvasive speech tests. IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering 57(4):884-893. doi:10.1109/TBME.2009.2036000.

fallback: pytorch_ridge only if linear cannot execute without modifying the package; no utility-triggered fallback

split.method: R set.seed(seed); sample sorted unique subjects for test; shuffle remaining subjects and deal round-robin to sites; no outcome stratification
split.overlap: No subject shared between training/test or between sites

bounds_policy: Fixed public clipping policy chosen before downloading or inspecting recordings. Age cap [18,100] for adults, binary sex [0,1], nonnegative perturbation/ratio measures with round-number engineering caps, HNR [-20,60] dB, normalized nonlinear measures [0,1]. Caps are declared admissible domains, not claimed UCI observed extrema or universal physical maxima. UPDRS I-III total scale [0,176]. All train and test branches use identical clipped affine feature transform; target remains in original UPDRS units.

privacy.randomness: unchanged persistent node secrets and canonical sticky seeding; split seeds are not DP noise seeds; no composition claim across trainings

central: OLS with intercept, numpy.linalg.lstsq rcond=None, on training subject means after the same public clipping/affine transform as the runner; unmodified continuous target units

metrics.unit: all recordings belonging to held-out subjects, recording-weighted

acceptance.criterion: mean federated RMSE < mean trivial RMSE and mean federated R2 > 0; additionally report per-seed pass/fail

selection: No tuning, inner validation, test-guided selection, or rescoring. A completed cell cannot be overwritten.
